title: ziviSpaceEcho
description: ziviSpaceEcho is a REAPER JSFX plugin for RE-201 inspired tape echo, spring reverb, dub delay textures and unstable motor-style modulation. It combines a multi-head tape echo structure, a parallel spring reverb branch, tape coloration controls, motor behavior controls and a custom cabinet-style graphical interface. Generative AI assistance, including GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT (GPT-5.5 Thinking) by OpenAI, used during development, documentation and release organization is disclosed in the repository file AI_USAGE.md.
